method: Closed measured flame blocks placed in real vertical courses with a shared floor, solid interior cubes and four detached sparks. Each block uses a uniform palette pigment; the PNG is not projected onto geometry.
inferred: Depth and hidden volume are inferred from the one-view concept. Interior cube pigments are estimated from coarse source color regions. No simulation or physical balance claim.
core_method: Ten measured cream cubes, depth-adjusted central stack; generated interior cubes cannot occlude measured cream surfaces in the reference view.
